vetSays.line: A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself." The pantry won't fill itself.
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.

🛡️ A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek catches you eyeing the bark plates — claw-scored, vine-laced. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They talk you through it — wide strips dried flat, laced overlapping like shingles, snug but not tight. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
📋 A person, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
🛡️ Cesar, Terry, Carmela and Siyabonga met them at the door — 4 put down. Cesar, Carmela, Siyabonga are hurt.
🛡️ Cesar, Terry, Carmela and Seo-yeon met them at the door — 4 put down. Cesar, Terry, Carmela, Seo-yeon are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Cesar just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Cesar, Terry, Carmela and Seo-yeon met them at the door — 4 put down. Cesar, Carmela, Seo-yeon are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Siyabonga just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikolai just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Vasyl just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nikolai just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Greta taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Greta is showing everyone European Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
